openings.claim: Use four strips and supplied M4 bolts for cork-contact guides and pivoting straps: opposing stops capture nonworking margins through existing slots, shifting retention from magnet/friction dependence to contact boundaries; accessible tabs permit gloved release.
openings.discriminator: Rival: magnet-assisted friction clamp. Predict ≤1 mm spare-plate movement with stops engaged and magnetic assistance absent despite 3 N versus 7 N pull. Magnetic pull alone does not predict stroke slip, and passing displacement tests alone cannot exclude friction.
openings.probe: Measure slots, margins and clearance; sketch stops and removal path. Proceed only if bolts fit, strips form with pliers, and guides/top restraint/release fit. Drill strips only; never drill, cut, heat or glue plate/carriage. Keep rails attached, marked 30 mm edge exposed, and all additions outside stroke clearance. Fabricate within eighty minutes. Within twenty observation minutes, use one configuration for three twenty-manual-stroke runs, spare last; mark away from edge and measure displacement. Perform three removal/return checks, final wearing thick gloves; handle nonworking margins only. Require every run ≤1 mm and every check ≤60 seconds; check returned position. Observe stop contact, bolt loosening and interference.
openings.uncertainty: Slot fit/travel, strip thickness/formability/strength, stroke loads, accessible margins and gloved fastener access are unknown. Guide flexure, inaccessible releases, interference or failed displacement/time limits defeat the candidate; abandon if unbuildable within supplied resources. No performance is demonstrated.

lineage.reason: Retained the sole current opening, preserving contact-capture causality, rival, bounded probe and feasibility caveats.

decision: Advance D1 only to feasibility measurement and the bounded probe. Preserve every hard constraint; do not infer retention from pull strength or claim deployment fitness. One configuration respects the two-configuration maximum; no additional raw opening exists.
